pinned_native_api.candidate_bond_rule: Euclidean reference-coordinate distance <= per-point horizon delta
pinned_native_api.existing_filter: point-set precrack cross-set pair filtering only
pinned_native_api.body_geometry_state: Body retains point positions, point volumes, material/point sets and parameters; no source CAD, solid occupancy, or tet adjacency field

precrack_semantics.update_dmg_false: Set-cross bonds are filtered during native system construction and removed from system.n_neighbors; this is the closest precedent for topological no-bond semantics.
precrack_semantics.update_dmg_true_default: Set-cross bonds remain in the graph and are made inactive during initialization, producing initial material damage.
precrack_semantics.limitation: Neither mode performs pairwise segment visibility; set cross-products cannot encode arbitrary geometry-screened pairs.

volume_and_fragment_interfaces.native_abaqus_input: read_inp supports Tet4/Hex8 and converts each element to a point center and element volume; element connectivity is not returned to Body.
volume_and_fragment_interfaces.current_forge_asset: surface vertices/faces with fields; surface-to-volume discretization and void-topology checks are unsupported, and solver is not launched.
volume_and_fragment_interfaces.occ_clipped_cell_experiment: Produces static CAD-clipped point/volume candidates; explicitly not solver input or a bond graph.
volume_and_fragment_interfaces.current_fragment_meaning: Endpoint connected components of the intact native horizon-bond graph; not verified rigid fragments. R2 and crack-surface lineage are not derived.

recommended_policy.acceptance: Create a native bond only for IN_MATERIAL. OUT_OR_VOID and UNKNOWN are excluded from the mechanics graph; keep UNKNOWN reason/count auditable.
recommended_policy.segment_rule: Both endpoints must be unambiguously inside the same material body/component and every open interval between all source-boundary hits must classify inside that material.
recommended_policy.reference_state: Classify once in undeformed reference coordinates and keep the mask static.
recommended_policy.numeric_rule: Grazing, near-coplanar, unresolved thin intervals, topology defects, float32/source-tolerance uncertainty, or ambiguous all-hit ordering => UNKNOWN; never force an uncertain bond active.
recommended_policy.asset_admission_gate: Do not silently equate UNKNOWN with OUT_OR_VOID. Aggregate UNKNOWN pairs, affected points, local horizon-family support, connectivity, and critical thin-wall regions. If a predeclared bound is exceeded or geometry precision/support is insufficient in a critical region, classify the whole asset UNKNOWN/NOT_ADMITTED and do not launch a physical solve.
recommended_policy.integration_point: Filter canonical candidate pairs in the native bond-construction stage before final neighbor counts, bond IDs, correction, kernels, and storage are built. Preserve reciprocal directed state symmetry.
recommended_policy.topology_ledger: Persist geometry-excluded candidate pairs and reasons separately from constitutive bond state and dynamic break events. Geometry exclusions are no-bonds, not step-zero damage, fracture events, broken_bonds, or R2 events.

implementation_routes.method: Intersect each candidate segment with every boundary of the authoritative closed source solid, sort all parameter hits, and classify each resulting open interval with the solid classifier.
tradeoffs: Directly handles inner cavities and multiple exits/re-entries.
Requires authoritative, closed, classifiable source geometry and robust hit grouping.
Current surface-only asset needs a validated volume/occupancy contract first.

implementation_routes.method: Traverse original Tet4 cells intersecting the segment; require same-material tetra interiors to cover all of [0,1], with conservative handling at shared faces/edges.
tradeoffs: Fits volume-mesh input and provides explicit occupied cells.
Must run before read_inp discards element connectivity or preserve the mesh adjacency.
Depends on tetra quality and the volume mesh boundary approximation.

implementation_routes.method: Cover the full segment with traversed cells and use an error-bounded signed-distance/Lipschitz occupancy bound; boundary/uncertain cells return UNKNOWN.
tradeoffs: Memory and resolution cost can be high.
Simple point sampling can miss thinner material/void crossings and is insufficient.

osb_mechanics.weighted_volume: calc_weighted_volume multiplies each term by bond_active.
osb_mechanics.dilatation: calc_dilatation multiplies its sum by bond_active and uses the weighted volume from the same eligible family.
osb_mechanics.failure_if_activity_flag_only: Marking geometric exclusions inactive while leaving system.n_neighbors unchanged reports fictitious initial damage. bond_active is a constitutive break state, not a static topology flag.
osb_mechanics.correction_and_rebuild: Energy surface correction uses the bond graph during initialization. Build final admissible neighbors/counts before correction, kernel, and storage initialization; endpoint/late deletion cannot undo already-computed mechanics.

calibration_boundary.visibility_rule: An explicit material-interaction-domain model choice beyond the pinned native Euclidean horizon search.
must_remain_distinct: point spacing h and thin-wall spatial resolution
calibration_boundary.required_comparisons: Use the same declared visibility rule and calibrated physical inputs across controls; assess spatial refinement and thin-wall response separately.
calibration_boundary.prohibited_substitute: Do not reduce delta or coarsen point spacing to hide cross-void candidates; no universal wall-thickness/delta ratio is asserted by this review.
calibration_boundary.unresolved_source_geometry: UNKNOWN or reject the geometry input; never convert unresolved thin-wall or float32 ambiguity into an active bond.

minimum_control_design.expected: Existing 125-point solid zero-load coupon keeps exactly its original candidate bond set; zero geometry exclusions and no mask-induced damage/events/R2 changes.

Endpoints on opposite inner-wall sides are both IN and within delta while their segment passes through cavity: classify AIR_PATH/no-bond. Keep known valid within-wall and wall-thickness material paths. Boundary-uncertain pairs classify UNKNOWN; if they affect critical wall support or exceed a predeclared bound, the asset remains UNKNOWN/NOT_ADMITTED.

Both endpoints inside nearby handle/body solids and within delta while the path exits through air: no-bond. A known fused-material attachment path stays eligible; independent bodies use contact semantics.

acceptance_gates: Pair mask is canonical and reciprocal.
Per-point system.n_neighbors equals final admissible graph degree before storage initialization.
OSB weighted volume and dilatation use the same final graph; energy surface correction is initialized from it.
Geometry exclusions are absent from dynamic broken-bond/event/damage/R2 outputs and present in a separate topology ledger.
UNKNOWN pairs are separately aggregated; critical or excessive uncertainty blocks asset admission rather than being silently labeled air.
Solid coupon graph is unchanged; hollow shell and handle-gap false bridges are excluded; valid in-material paths remain.
No Julia, solver, CAD, or tests were run during this review.
